verdict.rationale: Coinbase's docs describe x402 as "an open standard" for HTTP per-request payments. The protocol has been contributed to the Linux Foundation's x402 Foundation, which provides vendor-neutral governance and a Technical Steering Committee, and the docs reference an explicit x402 v2, so the protocol is versioned. A runtime probe shows the protocol SDK is publicly installable from npm (published by the x402 Foundation) without credentials; only the optional hosted facilitator requires a key. Missing for 10: no evidence pointing directly to the published spec document or repository, no stated spec license or confirmation that no agreement or CLA is needed to implement, and no independent hands-on report of implementing from the spec.
